summary: Round-2 long-tail repair, large verified progress, not all classes at zero. Fixed through shared paths (each executed-and-compared at 1 and 4 workers where it compiles): (1) frontend is-fold: ConstexprEnv's truthy NOT_CONSTEXPR sentinel leaked through 'if not result' and folded 'dtype is tl.bfloat16' True for EVERY dtype -- dtype 'is' now folds by represented-type identity (max_kernel's fp64 buffers took the fp32 arm and the TIR verifier refused the loop-carried contradiction; now an artifact, executes PASS). (2) return_indices promotion: pinned max/min(return_indices=True) promotes bfloat16 only; the blanket <32-bit promotion re-typed argmin's fp16 loop-carried min_vals mid-loop (argmin f16 artifacts, execute PASS). (3) scan: the scan runs at the OPERAND's own SEW (f32 operand in a 16-bit pass), the chunk carry threads through source loops and the early-return if (the carry was the scan loop's exit param -- undefined on the return path), the workspace scales by the operand's element size (cumprod_dim1 f32/f16/bf16 artifacts, execute PASS at 1 and 4). (4) ConstVal if-join sides reach the MIR lowering materialized (was a sweep-crashing AttributeError). (5) masked-scalar-load guard arms scope the values cache (a CSE-merged 'other' const materialized in one arm was read in a sibling -- use-before-def). (6) a select between two MASK values composes with mask logic (topk_stage1 was 'a vm value has no vsetvli region'; executes PASS). (7) tl.rand accepts a seed broadcasting one rank-0 scalar (linear_dropout executes PASS). (8) the chunked-region no-merge-rule guard applies to SCALAR joins only -- block joins stage per-lane (matmul_0a4f4889, qr artifacts, execute PASS); nested cross-pass liveouts register per (region, arm) as the emission looks them up; rank-0 pure converts/fulls/selects re-materialize at their use (l1_norm_7f6ce49c, unique_dim_row execute PASS); the {0,1}-class candidate narrows through the vector lane (median's merge width). (9) the chunk records the frames it opened with (a nested segmentation's re-filter misaligned the back edge's args) and a mid-list block statement can no longer open a chunk under a stale merge filter (naive_attn compiles past the old 'never initialized' refusal). Filtered sweep over the 48 owned operators: 233 identities, 147 artifacts (baseline 106), 86 located refusals, 0 crashes, all sweep checks PASS; tl.rand/tl.max/region/tir-verifier/arith.add and the unclassifiable cvt/cvt/f/id rows all at zero. Two repairs were REVERTED after execution exposed wrong code: the unconditional merge-frame passthrough bound the merged value to the identity (nansum harness form stored 0.0 for a 0.787 sum -- back to the located merge refusal), and the multi-axis last-axis scan acceptance miscompiled masked_cumsum_vec (15740/16384 mismatched; the 1x1 grouped_mixed case that compared PASS was vacuous -- back to the located tl.cumsum/cumprod refusal). Remaining classes: allocation 66 (the next broken stage, 21 operators), tl.sort 6, tl.cumsum/cumprod 3, merge 3, tl.histogram 2, convert 2, tl.dot 1, layout 1, ptradd 1, mir-verifier 1. naive_attn compiles but its execution faults under the pinned QEMU (open defect, see debug_request).
